checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Home screen at 1 s, workout at 4.1 s and 7.1 s.

must.item: Screenshots recognizable and readable, no invented UI
must.why: The screen text is warped and garbled (e.g. 'Sleep 7 h 10 min', 'Workout' distorted). The AI rebuilt the screens inside a phone mockup. The layout is roughly right but the text is not readable.
Clean blue FitTrack with a green line on white.
Audio is present, peak 0 dB, but its content cannot be judged.

faults.what: Text on the phone screens is garbled and smeared, e.g. 'Water' line illegible, 'Workout' and 'Warm-up' distorted. The screenshots are not faithfully reproduced.
The frame at 4.1 s shows the workout screen with no list items, only the header, and the phone is cropped off the edge of the frame.
The phone mockup was added and the screens were rebuilt rather than using the supplied screenshots.

summary: The ad has the right structure, with clean visuals and a good FitTrack end card. The app screens are AI-rebuilt with garbled, unreadable text, so the screenshots are not faithfully shown.
